name: ai-voice-wave
title: AI Voice Wave
description: A row of bars for voice input or output. Feed it live levels or let it pulse on its own while active. Static and level-shaped under reduced motion.

props.name: levels
props.description: Bar heights from 0 to 1, left to right. Leave it out for a built-in speech-like shape.

props.name: bars
props.description: Number of bars when levels is not given.

props.name: active
props.description: True while the voice is live. The bars move and the label says listening.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the wave in pixels.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name prefix. The state is added after it.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds for one pulse of a bar.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
